style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm feminine fragrance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm apricot background #F8DFAE, muted teal #4E7E7C, coral accent #E8956B and clean white #FFFFFF; soft warm key light from the left with gentle long shadows and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style in teal; clean high-end fragrance photography mixed with minimal rounded-card infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the round bottle; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the round bottle across the set, upright and centered
